definition: a liquid soap used for washing the hair
hook: Shampoo started out as a massage.
modernAnchor: A bottle in the shower, a lather in your hair. We call it shampoo.
journey: Hindi champo is the command to press, the word for kneading tired muscles.
British traders in India picked it up in the 1700s and brought the word home as shampooing, meaning a massage.
In 1814 Sake Dean Mahomed opened a shampooing bath house in Brighton, and the fashion for it spread through England.
By the 1860s the word had slid from the massage to the head, and then to the soap itself.
